entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... hello? I need to return something, I think. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, yes, let me find it... It's VF88602.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. I see an order for one VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Okay, great. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I don't think I'll use it. I tried to return it right before Christmas, but I ran into a huge website error. The whole page just wouldn't load properly.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened on the website?

I went to the returns page, but I couldn't print the label. It kept giving me a timeout message. I think your whole system was down. I was so frustrated I even took a screenshot of the error screen. Can't you just help me? I'm not very good with this stuff.

Of course, I can help. And thank you for that detail. Let me just check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, it looks like we did have a known service outage that day that impacted the returns portal. I do apologize for that.
Let me review our return policy for you... one moment please.
Okay, I have good news. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received your VeloBand on December 15th, you are well within that window.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline because of the website problem.

Not at all. I am processing the return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. All you need to do is print it out and attach it to the original box. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so much easier. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
